_description: Shared model registry for all AIXIA-workspace projects. Projects resolve model family → current_version at runtime from this file. Maintained by the bi-weekly model-release crawler (scheduled trigger). See ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md §9.5 for policy.
_bootstrap_note: This is the bootstrap state from 2026-04-20. Entries marked bootstrap_unverified: true are seeded from CLAUDE Code context and should be verified on the first crawler run. Pricing drifts; registry values are authoritative — always re-read at call-time.

claude_opus.notes: UPDATED Jul 27, 2026: claude-opus-4-8 → claude-opus-5 (released July 24, 2026). Pricing unchanged: $5/$25 per million tokens — same cost as Opus 4.8, at significantly higher capability. Anthropic positions it as 'close to Fable 5 intelligence at half Fable 5's price.' Benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified 96.0% (up from 69.2%), SWE-bench Pro 79.2%, FrontierBench v0.1 43.3% at max effort. Leads the field on Anthropic's agentic-coding eval (ahead of Fable 5's 33.7% and GPT-5.6 Sol's 34.4%). 1M context window (default and max), 128K output tokens. New default on Claude Max plan. Fast Mode remains available at $10/$50 per million. Available on Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI. Predecessor claude-opus-4-8 no longer listed as current; projects should migrate to claude-opus-5. Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change.

claude_fable.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. 🟢 API remains restored (was suspended June 12–July 1, 19 days). Context: US government export-control directive lifted after Anthropic added cybersecurity classifier and widened safety margin. Pricing: $10/$50 per million tokens; prompt caching $1/M cache hits; batch API $5/$25 per million. NOTE: With claude-opus-5 now at $5/$25, Fable 5 remains the top tier only for tasks specifically requiring its safety guardrails or where Opus 5's benchmark ceiling is insufficient. Backstory on suspension preserved for audit trail.

claude_sonnet.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no version or pricing change. 🚨 PRICING ALERT: claude-sonnet-5 launch rate $2/$10 per million expires August 31, 2026 — 22 DAYS FROM NOW. Standard rate $3/$15 takes effect September 1, 2026 (50% input increase, 50% output increase). All AIXIA project cost models budgeted at the launch rate must be updated BEFORE SEPTEMBER 1 — this is not a watch item, it is an active deadline. Context window 1M tokens, up to 128K output tokens. Most agentic Sonnet yet; default on Free and Pro plans. Available on Claude API, Bedrock, Vertex AI.

claude_haiku.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. Pricing and version stable at $1/$5 per million. claude-haiku-3-5 retired (Anthropic notified Dec 19, 2025; shutdown occurred 2026). claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 remains the current Haiku tier.

deepseek_general.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; version unchanged. 🚨 PRICE HIKE WARNING (Aug 6, 2026): DeepSeek announced API prices will rise 'significantly' in the near term — no effective date or new rate published yet. Current rates ($0.14/$0.28) are still active but should be treated as temporary. All AIXIA projects routing to deepseek_general must prepare budget contingencies for a potential large increase. Monitor DeepSeek's API docs page weekly. ⚠️ DEPRECATION (Jul 24, 2026): Legacy aliases deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner retired; registry uses canonical IDs (deepseek-v4-flash) — audit any hardcoded legacy strings in call sites. GA since mid-July 2026. 284B total / 13B active params (MoE), 1M context, 384K max output, Thinking+Non-Thinking dual mode. Peak pricing: 2× during Beijing business hours (09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 CST). Cache hits: $0.0028/M. Chinese-server jurisdiction — disclose in ToS.

deepseek_reasoning.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. Pricing confirmed $0.55/$2.19 (cache hits: $0.14/M input). 🚨 PRICE HIKE WARNING (Aug 6, 2026): DeepSeek announced across-the-board API price increases 'in the near term' — no effective date or new rates published yet. Monitor DeepSeek API docs weekly for R1 rate changes. ⚠️ DEPRECATION (Jul 24, 2026): Legacy alias deepseek-reasoner retired — use deepseek-r1 directly. DeepSeek R2 not released this cycle. gemini_pro_multimodal.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; version and pricing unchanged. ⚠️ Gemini 3.5 Pro STILL NOT GA — slipped past the 'end of June' target, the July 17 target, and as of early August 2026 remains listed as 'coming soon' on the Gemini API model page with no new date announced. The Gemini API model list has no gemini-3.5-pro entry in Stable or Preview; the newest callable Pro remains gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Rumored: 2.1M context, Deep Think reasoning mode, ~$15/$60 per million tokens (unconfirmed). Do NOT update this entry until Google publishes an official model card. CURRENT: Gemini 3.1 Pro at $2/$12 up to 200K tokens; $4/$18 above 200K. Paid-only (free tier removed April 1, 2026). YouTube URL ingest via file_data.file_uri. NOTE: With Gemini 3.6 Flash now available (see gemini_flash), consider routing non-pro multimodal tasks there at lower cost.

gemini_flash.notes: UPDATED Jul 27, 2026: gemini-3.5-flash → gemini-3.6-flash (released July 21, 2026). Output pricing reduced: $9.00 → $7.50 per million tokens (~17% reduction). Input pricing unchanged at $1.50/M. Context: 1,048,576 tokens; output cap: 65,536 tokens (64K). Speed: ~280 tokens/sec. Uses ~17% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash. Stronger on coding, long-context, and computer-use benchmarks. Knowledge cutoff advanced to March 2026. Accepts text, image, video, audio, PDF. Cached input: $0.15/M (90% discount). Non-global regions: $1.65/$8.25. Batch API: 50% discount. Also launched alongside: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber (niche variants — not tracked separately). Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. PRIOR: gemini-3.5-flash at $1.50/$9.00 is superseded.

openai_gpt.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no API pricing or version change. GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna) launched July 9, 2026. Sol: $5/$30, Terra: $2.50/$15, Luna: $1/$6 per million tokens; all at 1.05M context. Long-context surcharge: >272K input billed at $10/$45 for full request. Cache: $0.50/M cache hits, $6.25/M cache writes, 30-min minimum cache life. Multi-agent mode (beta). August 6, 2026: OpenAI made GPT-5.6 Luna the default model for Free and Go consumer plans (no API change). Not currently used by AIXIA projects. Fine-tuning API deprecated.

openai_reasoning.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. o4-mini outperforms o3-mini at ~50% lower cost. o3 also available ($2.00/M input, 200K context). Reasoning tokens billed at output rate — effective cost 5–20× listed rate. No o5 release confirmed this cycle. Not currently used by AIXIA projects.

mistral_medium.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. Mistral Medium 3.5 (April 29, 2026): dense 128B open-weight; unifies instruction-following, reasoning, and coding. 256K context, EU data residency. Output cost ($7.50/M) is 5× mistral_large — only worth it when unified reasoning+coding at long context is required.

mistral_reasoning.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. magistral-medium-2506: $2.00/$5.00 per million tokens, 41K context. Budget option: magistral-small-2506 at $0.50/$1.50, 40K context. EU data residency via La Plateforme. Compact context (41K) suits focused reasoning — switch to mistral_medium (256K) when long context is also needed.

llama.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no new open-weight Llama release this cycle. Llama 4 Maverick remains current: 17B active params, 128 experts (400B total), 1M context, natively multimodal MoE. Pricing reflects third-party providers (Together AI, Fireworks, Groq, AWS Bedrock). Also: Llama 4 Scout ($0.15/$0.60, 10M context) for extreme-context tasks; Llama 4 Behemoth (288B active) still not GA. Meta's Muse Spark (proprietary, closed) not tracked here — not available via open-weight routes. Community sentiment has cooled on Llama 4 trajectory; 11 of 14 original Llama 2023 paper researchers have left Meta. Zuckerberg admitted AI agent progress is running behind plan.

Knowledge cutoff: February 1, 2026.

routing_defaults.description: Canonical default routing for common task categories. Projects override as needed in their local CLAUDE.md.

privacy_mode_routing.description: When a project/tier enables Privacy Mode, all calls route through Claude only (no DeepSeek, no third-party-jurisdiction routes). Studio-tier Echoform users default to Privacy Mode.
